caption: Stromboli and Sciara del Fuoco, Aeolian Islands
composition: Volcanic cone with Sciara glow from the sea · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the open sea, the camera frames Stromboli's perfect volcanic cone silhouetted against the first light of the 06:13 dawn. The Sciara del Fuoco glows molten orange down the right flank of the otherwise black mountain, a thin plume drifting from the summit, while pink and gold sunrise color spreads along the left horizon. Dark water fills the foreground, rippling faintly beneath the changing sky.
